mokurai_palm_projectile.title: Golden Divine Palm (Chakra Wave)
mokurai_palm_projectile.description: Mokurai thrusts an open palm forward, emitting a massive golden energy palm that travels across the screen, pushing and damaging opponents.

directional_aiming.control_type: D-Pad / Joystick angle hold on activation frame

timing_breakdown.startup: Frames 0-1: Palm gathers glowing golden chakra at chest.
timing_breakdown.release: Frame 2: Forward/directional palm thrust spawning the projectile.
timing_breakdown.travel: Frames 3-4: Energy palm expands and travels along designated angle.
timing_breakdown.recovery: Frames 5-6: Mokurai settles back into neutral stance.

mokurai_palm_projectile.engine_note: LIVE since 265 (flat forward). SHEET_V 281 adds the 4-way aim (Up held = straight up · Back+Up = up-diagonal · Back+Down = down-diagonal) and projectile pierce. Damage stays 24 (engine convention; spec's 22 noted).

meditation_auto_dodge.title: Zen Mind Auto-Dodge (Mu-Shin)
meditation_auto_dodge.description: Mokurai enters a motionless meditation state. Any incoming physical or energy hit triggers an automatic fluid slip dodge or teleport counter.

mechanic.on_hit_reaction: Triggers instant behind-target slip dodge with 0ms startup

meditation_auto_dodge.engine_note: ALREADY LIVE as Enlightenment (265): hold Down+Guard 2s channel -> 5s auto-dodge/auto-block + +3 dmg, once/round. Time-limited rather than the spec's drain-per-second — shipped shape stands (owner-approved).
